items.review_rationale: Read a strict groupoid-valued presheaf as an ordinary functor from C-opposite to the category of groupoids, with contravariant pullback functors satisfying literal composition and identity equalities.

references.phrase: category Groupoids of groupoids and functors
references.context: Target 1-category whose objects are groupoids and morphisms ordinary functors.
Functor induced contravariantly from f:V→U in base C.

references.disposition: The equalities hold on the nose, not merely up to pseudofunctorial natural isomorphism.

items.review_rationale: Read a split category fibred in groupoids by isomorphism over its base category to a Grothendieck construction of a strict contravariant groupoid-valued functor, preserving the strict-versus-pseudo distinction.

references.phrase: Grothendieck construction of a presheaf of groupoids
references.context: Category of pairs (U,x∈F(U)) with base arrows and corresponding compatible pullback arrows, projecting to C.
Isomorphism of categories commuting with both projection functors to C, not merely arbitrary abstract equivalence.
